proposed_concrete_profile.origin: reuse existing successfully loaded BootstrapDeployment original grant path/SHA + registry directory/config pins
proposed_concrete_profile.mechanism: new opaque concrete local-file profile/factory in separate A2 source pair; direct ReadBootstrapGrantFile and RegistrationFiles methods under original deployment-owned paths, not invocation of arbitrary BootstrapAdmissionSources functions under locks
proposed_concrete_profile.not_authority: profile gives only provenance and bounded original file reads; original independent deployment/resource authority remains mandatory
proposed_concrete_profile.stages: current grant+RBAC on both branches before L3 and before fixed FinalGuard; full9 source checks only on fresh resource/new-use and final-new branch. Original raw bounds/data remain unchanged and deadlines never renew.
proposed_concrete_profile.time: shared SQL SampleTime before/after bounded local source reads, single min caller/config attempt ctx, fixed D readback and final clock afterward without further callbacks/files
proposed_concrete_profile.compatibility: existing generic snapshot constructor remains explicitly limited; production assembly must use reviewed concrete current-source profile, no approved/local_safe boolean or new grant.

required_regressions: Original actual grant file removed/changed after Prepare and during prefix wait: reject both new and exact historical attempt, no business writes/second charge.
Original actual RBAC file deleted/changed or role binding removed after Prepare: reject both branches even with unchanged cached RBAC/window.
Full g/notBefore/expires original-file pin mismatch or apparent renewed expiry cannot extend the captured original deadline.

Non-authorizing non-RBAC resource registry removed/changed after preparation: reject new use before reservation/audit and at final check, but do not preempt otherwise authorized L3 exact historical read.
Arbitrary source callback that can call network is never defaulted to safe late local-file work; fail when concrete original controlled profile is absent.
All late read waits/context cancellation/SQL rollback/strict expiry equality still reject through shared monotonic sample and D final deadline.
